h:
这是我的 comfyui 工作流程，希望对您有所帮助。

对于V2版本，我用LoRA Manager替换了原来的LoRA堆栈，以便于管理。 Image Plus 可以方便地保存图像元数据。

我为V2单独设置了这个新的ComfyUI；插件与我的旧设置有冲突，所以我以前从未使用过这些功能。但每次都手动上传图片很麻烦，所以我就新建了一个。

我想添加一些扩展，比如放大、恢复、提示提取、图库、ControlNet等，你可以自己扩展——我懒得处理，很痛苦。

anima_workflow 仅用于 anima

o.en:
This is my comfyui workflow,i hope it can help you.

For the V2 version, I replaced the original LoRA stack with LoRA Manager for easier management. Image Plus is handy for saving image metadata.

I set up this new ComfyUI separately for V2; there were plugin conflicts with my old setup, so I never used these features before. But manually uploading images every time was a hassle, so I just built a new one.

I want to add extensions like upscaling, restoration, prompt extraction, gallery, ControlNet, etc. You can expand it yourself—I’m too lazy to deal with it, it’s a pain.

anima_workflow only be used for anima

v2单独新开的comfyui搭的，以前的插件冲突没用这玩意，但确实自己每次传图麻烦，索性搭了一个。想扩展放大，修复，反推提示词，d画廊，controlnet啥的，自己扩吧，我懒得整了，麻烦。

rf_workflow只能用于rf模型，用别的把model sampling sd3 结点删了就行
